name: ModelVariant755_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant755_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the ambient light dims while sixteen animated sparks spray from a model part and, every period, another of up to 128 shards leaves it for a jittered point near the opposing slot, growing as it flies. On arrival each shard bursts into a six-frame flash and four tinted fragments that drift apart; once the last shard has burst after spawning ends, the light comes back); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-755 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant755_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH at the same addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
